_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. dub.co's marketing site and app.dub.co auth shell declare a semantic + shadcn token layer in their Next.js/Tailwind bundles and paint it light; the Mintlify docs/help surface adds the --gray ramp and the site's only real theme toggle (the html.dark scope resolved as the dark set). Declared variables become var leaves; the Tailwind neutral ramp, the oklab color-mix washes, the component geometry and the state values the atomic CSS never names are measured leaves from raw/components-computed.json.
